<!-- pr-reviewer: e782fbd12388c9fd3526d26984165126a56a7b8a -->
**Needs changes before merge.** The code and the pinning test are good. The skill text omits one of the three wire posts that the server has.

### What looks good

- `push_missing_fields` (`crates/app/src/mcp/job.rs`) puts the 10 Wire Contour fields that serialization skips into `list_operation_types`. The `break_through` injection now uses the same helper, and its behavior does not change.
- The new test makes a `WireContourDto` with no default values and compares its serialized keys with the listed fields. Thus a new DTO field that is not listed makes the test fail.
- The skill now gives the correct tool rule (`"mounts_tool": true`, a `Wire` tool such as `EDM-W025`). The new statements agree with the code:
  - The `side` values `die`, `punch`, `left` and `right` agree with `WireSideDto`.
  - The wire tool limits (diameter 0.02-1.0 mm, `rpm: 0`) agree with `crates/tools/src/wire.rs`.
  - The two built-in machine names agree with `crates/app/src/posting_files.rs:153-154`.
  - `load_machine { "builtin": ... }` is a correct call.
- The issue #3217 "done" condition (a test compares the field list) is met.
- `Process change: yes` is in the body, and `.claude/PROCESS_VERSION` is not edited. The `Changelog:` line and `Fixes #3217` are in the body.
- This is not a safety-tier change. It does not change posted G-code, gouge or collision checks, stock simulation or geometry.

### Results, merged with main (locally)

Trial merge of `e782fbd12` with `upstream/main`: clean, no conflicts.

| Step | Result |
|---|---|
| `cargo xtask gate quick --base upstream/main` | 25/25 steps ok (app build, `lib`, 23 integration suites, `mcp_wire_contour` included) |
| `cargo test -p camcraft-app --test mcp_doc_drift --test mcp_wire_contour` | 6 passed, 8 passed |
| `cargo clippy -p camcraft-app --all-targets -- -D warnings` | clean |

Extra suites run: `mcp_doc_drift`. The diff does not touch `testdata/` or importer code, so no extra test-data or importer suites apply.

Mutation: I removed `("sharp_corners", ...)` from the injected list. `list_operation_types_and_skill_match_wire_contour_dto_and_tool_law` failed with `list_operation_types wire_contour fields must match WireContourDto`. I restored the line.

### Requested before merge

1. `.claude/skills/camcraft-mcp/SKILL.md:148`: the sentence "Post with `"Generic ISO Wire EDM"` ... or `"Sodick Wire EDM (Mark 21)"` ...; milling posts refuse wire cuts by name" names only two wire posts. The server has three. `crates/app/src/posting.rs:62` is `WIRE_POSTS = ["Generic ISO Wire EDM", "Sodick Wire EDM (Mark 21)", agie::POST]`, and `crates/app/src/posting_agie.rs:17` sets `agie::POST` to `"Agie native wire EDM"`. That post came with commit `3845cb70e`, which is already in your trial-merge base `43217a7c4`. The skill names the `AGIECUT Classic 2S (template)` machine, but it does not tell an agent that this machine has its own native post with its own limits (the `AGIE_QN2` condition, see `docs/user-guide/agie-wire-edm.md`). Add `"Agie native wire EDM"` to the post list, with one short clause about its scope. Then add the name to the `required` list of the test, so that the skill cannot lose it again.
2. PR body: the "What changed" list names the posts as `Sodick Wire` and `AGIECUT Wire`. These names do not exist. Use the real post names (see item 1). The body also says that `crates/app/tests/mcp_wire_contour.rs` was "added". The file was already there; the PR adds one test to it.

### Notes (not blocking)

- The body says that `push_missing_fields` reports all 13 fields. It adds 10 fields; `top_z`, `bottom_z` and `side` were already in the list. The result (13 fields) is correct.

A maintainer will approve and merge by hand.
﻿Moving to draft to address review findings: add Agie native wire EDM post to SKILL.md and mcp_wire_contour, and fix the post names and file wording in the PR body.

﻿Addressed both requested items on head 2726446c4c7954179724877203d1be0f8f5c117c: added "Agie native wire EDM" (AGIE_QN2 scope) to .claude/skills/camcraft-mcp/SKILL.md and mcp_wire_contour.rs, and corrected the post names and test-file note in the PR body. Separate gate-runner passed mcp_doc_drift (6/6), mcp_wire_contour (8/8), clippy, and cargo xtask gate quick (24/24). Ready for re-review.
